Neptune Internet questions

What is the cheapest Neptune Internet NBN plan?

NBN 25/10 at $60/mo. That is $720 over the first year (checked 29 August 2026).

Does Neptune Internet let you opt out of CGNAT?

Yes, Neptune Internet gives customers a public IP address free on request.

Do you need to give Neptune Internet 30 days notice to cancel?

No. Neptune Internet doesn't require a 30-day notice period to cancel.
